messages:
mika: Security/Platform heads up: starting a staged rollout of "signed-image enforcement" for Private installs. Goal: customers who opt-in will only be able to run images signed by their approved registries or by Redwood-verified publisher keys. This helps with supply-chain audits and SOC2 evidence.

secops: Why opt-in? Some customers run 3rd-party tooling that signs images differently. We want to avoid breaking existing installs while offering a hardened path.

daria: Ops notes: enforcement will be configurable via `image_policy.mode` (off | permissive | strict). Permissive logs violations but allows runtime; strict blocks unsigned images. We'll ship a migration tool to scan existing deployments.

mika: Sample config we plan to show in the KB:

```yaml
image_policy:
  mode: permissive  # off, permissive, strict
  allowed_registries:
    - registry.company.com:443
  accepted_signers:
    - redwood-infra-pubkey:v1
  audit_log_path: /var/log/redwood/image-policy.log
```

secops: Compliance: when strict mode is enabled customers should record a signed attestation listing allowed signers. We'll add this to the SOC2 artifacts appendix.

daria: Migration tool will run in dry-run by default and produce a report: unsigned-images.csv + suggested remediation steps. We'll include a `--fix` flag to optionally retag/repush signed copies to the customer's registry (requires credentials).

platform-bot: Docs drafted: private/signed-image-policy.md (author: mika)

docs-bot: KB published: private/signed-image-enforcement/faq.md (v0.9)

mika: Rollout plan: Week 1: internal-only deploy + run migration tool for beta customers. Week 2: invite-only opt-in, Week 4: GA opt-in and partner integrations. No automatic enforcement for existing customers without explicit opt-in.

secops: Action items: @daria add migration tool CLI to tools repo, @mika add attestation template to docs, @support add support-routing tag `signed-image-policy`. We'll have a 30-min review Wed 11am PT.

daria: I'll open the PR for the scanner and attach sample reports.

mika: Thanks team. This should make audits much smoother and reduce supply-chain risk for our Private customers. Ping me for edge cases or customer blockers.
